warfarin.aspirin: Major: Increased bleeding risk. Monitor INR closely.
warfarin.ibuprofen: Major: Increased bleeding risk. Avoid concurrent use.
warfarin.naproxen: Major: Increased bleeding risk. Monitor for bleeding.

lisinopril.potassium: Moderate: Risk of hyperkalemia. Monitor potassium levels.
lisinopril.spironolactone: Major: Risk of hyperkalemia. Monitor closely.

atorvastatin.erythromycin: Major: Increased risk of myopathy. Monitor for muscle pain.
atorvastatin.grapefruit: Moderate: May increase statin levels. Limit grapefruit intake.
